we can reduce our proposed fee to $1.5 million if Brightline increases the class fund to $32 million

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fee terms in their opening settlement term sheets, before class relief had been settled. Fee terms were part of the pre-agreement bargaining, and Whitcombe explicitly linked a reduced fee request to an increased class fund. The transcript does not clearly show plaintiff self-dealing, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration by the settling counsel.
